scenario: Hydration is not in v1, so a call to a declared service that happens to be named `storage.hydrate_events` is an ordinary call. It has no `retain:`, which no call honours ([LCRS.6.3.3]), and it compiles. A compiler that keys hydration checks on the name refuses this with DS_VALIDATE_HYDRATE_NO_RETAIN. PATH PINNED: `dsc.validate`'s rule checks, which do not ask a call's name.
rules_ds:
service storage.hydrate_events:
    no response

schema AlarmTriggered scope ttl 1_h:
    zone: String

rule r:
    AlarmTriggered
->
    call storage.hydrate_events cooldown: 23_h as "h"
